_doc: Head-phantom geometry for the API source mode — BGO ring at 2 radiation lengths, v2 CRYOSTAT variant: r_inner = the CsI R35 ring + 5 cm (BGO sits inside a cryostat; the crystals move 5 cm outward for the cryostat + insulation). crysp_r40_35cm: CsI R35 -> BGO r_inner 40.0 cm; n_phi recomputed at the fixed block face (~5.11 cm arc): 43 -> 49; n_z and AFOV unchanged (half_length 17.92 cm). This is the BGO counterpart of the CsI crysp_r35_35cm (the +5 cm is the cryostat penalty). wall = 2 X0 of BGO (2.236 cm). The config's [transport].crystal_material picks the crystal (BGO_195K produced). The phantom section is a PLACEHOLDER — replaced in mode="api" by the scenario phantom. Dimensions in cm.
